escalation_note: THE FILER'S ZERO AND HIS SIX ARE THE SAME GLYPH - a loop with a lead-in stroke - and the two can only be told apart by arithmetic. Fourteen amount cells were escalated to 1100-1800 dpi tight crops with the address column excluded. What the escalations established: (1) On p3 three cells carry the ambiguous glyph (rows 11, 14, 17). The other fourteen rows are unambiguous and sum to 8,565.00, so the three must total 350.00; of the eight possible assignments only 200.00 + 100.00 + 50.00 gives 350.00 (the others give 356, 410, 410, 416, 470, 476), so the closure is UNIQUE and the page closes exactly at its printed 8,915.00. My first reading of that page (260 / 100 / 56) summed 66.00 high and was WRONG. (2) The reference instance is the filer's OWN confirmed glyph: p4 row 17 is written identically and must be 200.00 for that page to close at its printed 8,960.00 - the ADDENDUM F6 standard of comparing a disputed digit to the same filer's arithmetically-confirmed instance elsewhere. (3) The same glyph is a genuine SIX at p4 row 6 (60.00) and p5 row 3 (60.00), both proved by their pages closing exactly - so the glyph cannot be resolved by shape in either direction, only by the page's arithmetic. (4) On p6 rows 4, 6, 7 and 9 and on p10 rows 2, 3, 7 and 13 the same ambiguity exists but those two pages do NOT close, so no arithmetic is available to settle them; they are retained as read with needs_review=1. p6 row 7 was cropped at 1800 dpi from the amount column's own left rule and rendered three digits, '224.37', with no bleed from the address column - it is not 24.37. ARITHMETIC CLOSURE OUTRANKS GLYPH READING (GOTCHAS / the Rhodes reversal) and that is exactly what decided every cell that could be decided.

notes: Darin Durfey, Utah County SHERIFF, 2018 cycle. PAGE-FACE CANDIDATE NAME IS 'Darin Durfey' while index.csv names NO candidate (the channel label is the reporting-period string 'Out at Convention - Durfey'); the page face governs. Office Seeking printed simply as 'Sheriff'; party Republican; residence city Santaquin. Report type: '30 Days after withdraw or elimination', signed 5-1-18, clerk stamp '18 MAY 1 AM 8:38. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS WHOLLY UNTICKED - neither Yes nor No - an honest BLANK, never read as 'No' (ADDENDUM A4). Single report, no bundle. ELEVEN pages: p1 cover / p2 SUMMARY PAGE / p3-p5 SCHEDULE A / p6-p11 SCHEDULE B, every page classified from its own printed heading; no checklist decoy. FOLIATION: the filer numbers his sheets 'Page 2 of 11' through 'Page 10 of 11' COUNTING THE COVER, and then repeats '10' on the eleventh page - a foliation slip, so the last sheet's own number does not identify it. The cover is the common 2018-era blank ('...FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES', Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5 & 20A-11-13) while all nine inner sheets are strap-lined '2016 County Commission & Local School Board Candidate' - leftover 2016 stock on a genuinely 2018 filing (utah-template-vintage-year), and note the strapline wording differs from the 2016 sheets seen elsewhere ('County Commission &' rather than 'County &'). Schedule B REUSES Schedule A's heading 'Name of Contributor' over the payee column and there is NO Purpose column, so purpose is honestly blank on all 89 expenditure rows; the columns are assignable by CONTENT (merchants, vendors, real addresses) and the field-shift screen passes. THE DOCUMENT IS UNREDACTED - it is not a *_Redacted.pdf and carries no bars; donor and vendor street lines are visible on the page and are deliberately reduced to city/state at read time (dropped entirely for expenditures). Contributions reconcile EXACTLY; expenditures carry a traced but not uniquely attributable +155.84 filer-arithmetic delta over two of six sheets - see recon.
